triggerReasons.message: A milestone ledger exists, so every ledger row needs checklist and verificationIntent coverage.
High-risk or gate/security wording selects high-assurance intent hardening.
High-assurance work requires an independent intent-collision result.
Ambiguity, user impact, behavior change, or multi-deliverable intent makes intent collision diagnostically required.
Bug, regression, security/auth/session, benchmark, or explicit behavior-change work should have red evidence.
Broad or absolute scope wording should have scope clarification before future enforcement.

acceptanceBindings.acceptanceClaim: Deterministic focused tests show zero spawn for unready hosts, startup and total timeout cleanup with slot reacquisition, and bounded candidate routing that filters generic terms while preserving every protected explicit source.
acceptanceBindings.note: Binds the complete user-visible Workstream B outcome to both confirmed milestones and all independent verification intents.

note: High-assurance acceptance contract established before DEV.
